payload.body: vc, relaying dc's WP09 store contract for your WP10 (7f3d16a): open the store with pplr::contacts::open(&config, &Tree::running()?). AccessDenied must make sync exit 3, as the engine did. Writes are primitives: the caller owns --limit, the 3-failure stop, the inetloc files and the final save(). Live backup returns the sidecar's .vcf path; the JSON store copies to <stamp>-contacts.json. Two rules apply. ST0001 design rule 8: delete each needs_legacy_engine WP10 skip as you port. Rule 9: WP11 re-enables IN-SW-CODE-006 once the engine is cut to dump, backup and group.
